_comment: Dev-set expansion for the agent-as-compiler run (round 2). Disjoint from nl_questions_poc.json, the 20-query dev benchmark, the compiler few-shots, and the held-out RulesGuru corpus.

questions.q: creatures that make each player sacrifice a creature when they enter the battlefield
enchantments that trigger whenever one of your creatures dies
cards that give all your creatures haste
creatures with a tap ability that adds one mana of any color
spells that counter an activated or triggered ability
sorceries that destroy all artifacts
lands that exile a player's entire graveyard when they enter
creatures with protection from red
spells that make each player discard their hand and draw seven cards
creatures that get a +1/+1 counter whenever they deal combat damage to a player
artifacts with a tap ability that deals 1 damage to any target
spells that prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn
spells that return all creatures to their owners' hands
creatures with an activated ability that regenerates them
sorceries that return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield
creatures that must attack each combat if able
instants that give a creature deathtouch until end of turn
cards that make spells cost more to cast
creatures with both flying and vigilance
cards that deal damage to each opponent whenever you cast an instant or sorcery

scenarios.q: I control Ajani's Pridemate and four Plains, and I cast Angel's Mercy. What are Pridemate's power and toughness, and my life total?
My opponent controls Grizzly Bears. I cast Last Gasp targeting it. Does it die?
I control Guttersnipe and cast Shock targeting my opponent. How much total damage does my opponent take?
I control Doubling Season and cast Krenko's Command. How many Goblin tokens do I get?
My opponent controls Darksteel Colossus. I cast Doom Blade targeting it. What happens?
I attack with Serra Angel and my opponent doesn't block. What is their life total after combat?
I cast Mind Rot on my opponent, who has exactly a Plains and an Island in hand. What is in their graveyard afterward?
I control two Grizzly Bears and cast Wrath of God. What survives on my battlefield?
